snippet.title: Sushi On Wheels - Run your Dream Sushi Truck in Japan - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Sushi On Wheels is a cozy management game where you run your dream sushi truck business in a Japanese setting inspired by the real life Izu Peninsula. Prep ingredients, customize your truck, and serve handmade sushi to hungry locals as you travel around Japan and complete your grandmother’s dream!

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3749760/Sushi_On_Wheels/
